title: Sofiane — Le book (version croquis)
style: Hand-drawn pencil and ink sketch illustration with soft watercolor washes, warm paper texture, expressive imperfect line work, heartfelt storybook style, muted warm palette

characters.name: Sofiane
characters.description: Sofiane, a 26-year-old North African man, short curly hair, tired but proud eyes, teal food-delivery jacket over a hoodie

characters.name: Rayan
characters.description: Rayan, a 31-year-old North African man, well-trimmed beard, camel overcoat, confident warm energy

characters.name: Nadia
characters.description: Nadia, a 45-year-old elegant businesswoman, silver-streaked dark hair in a low bun, burgundy blazer, sharp kind eyes

scenes.image_prompt: Sketch of Sofiane slumped at a tiny desk at night, head in his hands, laptop glowing, a mountain of crumpled rejection letters around him

scenes.vo: Sofiane a un master en marketing. Et un sac isotherme sur le dos.
scenes.image_prompt: Sketch of Sofiane in his teal delivery jacket standing in the rain with a big thermal food bag, a framed diploma ghosted in the cloudy sky above him

scenes.vo: Ce soir-là, devant le restaurant… son cousin Rayan.
scenes.image_prompt: Sketch of a night street, Rayan in camel coat stopping mid-step in surprise as he recognizes Sofiane holding a delivery bag, warm restaurant light spilling out
Close sketch of Rayan's stunned face, eyebrows raised, speech energy in the linework, night street background loosely drawn

scenes.vo: La honte. Le regard qui pique.
scenes.image_prompt: Close sketch of Sofiane looking down, jaw tight, gripping the strap of his delivery bag, rain hatching around him
Sketch of Rayan putting a firm warm hand on Sofiane's shoulder under a streetlamp, both faces serious and close

scenes.vo: « C'est pas ce que tu sais. C'est qui tu connais. »
scenes.image_prompt: Sketch of Rayan pointing gently, knowing look, a loose constellation of tiny drawn faces connected by pencil lines floating behind him like a network

scenes.vo: Et Sofiane, lui, ne connaît personne.
scenes.image_prompt: Wide sketch of Sofiane small on his scooter in an empty night avenue, vast negative space of blank paper around him

scenes.vo: Alors Rayan lui montre un dîner. Huit inconnus. Un vrai restaurant.
scenes.image_prompt: Sketch of the two men leaning over a phone, the screen showing a warm little drawn dinner-table icon with eight chairs, curiosity on Sofiane's face

scenes.vo: « Je vais dire quoi, moi ? Que je livre des makis ? »
scenes.image_prompt: Sketch of Sofiane gesturing at his own delivery jacket with self-mocking irony, one eyebrow raised

scenes.vo: « Que t'as faim de bosser. Le reste, ça se voit. »
scenes.image_prompt: Close sketch of Rayan's confident reassuring face, slight smile, direct eyes

scenes.vo: Jeudi soir. Chemise propre. Cœur qui tape.
scenes.image_prompt: Sketch of Sofiane in a clean white shirt pausing at the door of a warm candlelit restaurant, hand on the door handle, deep breath

scenes.vo: En face de lui : Nadia. Elle monte sa marque.
scenes.image_prompt: Sketch of Nadia at the dinner table, burgundy blazer, sharp kind eyes, candlelight, listening intently with her chin on her hand

scenes.vo: « Deux cents candidatures sans réponse ? Leur erreur. »
scenes.image_prompt: Close sketch of Nadia speaking with calm authority, a faint smile, warm dinner glow
Sketch of Nadia's hand passing a business card across the table, Sofiane receiving it with both hands like a treasure, candle flame between them

scenes.vo: Lundi, neuf heures. Le book est parti. Et tout a commencé par un dîner.
scenes.image_prompt: Sketch of Sofiane at dawn light clicking send on his laptop, a real smile, the business card pinned on the wall in front of him

scenes.vo: Ton réseau commence autour d'une vraie table. Nour Meet. Inscris-toi gratuitement.
